d: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed security personnel while celebrating Diwali in Bastar, declaring an end to decades of Left-Wing Extremism across India. Modi noted that this marks the first Diwali where every district in the country is free from Maoist terror, praising the sacrifices of the CRPF, state police forces, and specialized units. Highlighting the shift in national security policy since 2014, he pointed out that for the first time in 47 years, no CRPF personnel lost their lives on duty over the past year.
